meta.name: etetoolkit
meta.description: Analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Use for Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Do not use it to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and infer a tree first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析、比较与注释进化树
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果处理系统发育数据并需要比较树结构。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze, compare, and annotate phylogenetic trees.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with phylogenetic data and need to compare tree topologies.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能处理系统发育树：读取、修改、可视化树，检测进化事件（复制/物种形成），整合NCBI分类信息，比较树差异，输出PDF/SVG图。不能从序列推断树。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析、操作、比较、注释或可视化系统发育树或层次聚类树时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个Newick树文件用ETE加载并显示统计信息。
say.note: 返回树的叶节点数和总节点数。

say.text: 检测这个基因树中的复制和物种形成事件。
say.note: 标注出每个节点的进化类型。

say.text: 用NCBI分类信息注释这棵树的叶节点。
say.note: 添加物种的谱系和分类ID。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can handle phylogenetic trees: read, modify, visualize trees, detect evolutionary events (duplication/speciation), integrate NCBI taxonomy, compare tree topologies, and output PDF/SVG figures. Cannot infer trees from sequences.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, or visualize phylogenetic or hierarchical clustering trees.

say_en.text: Load this Newick tree file with ETE and show statistics.
say_en.note: Returns leaf count and total node count.

say_en.text: Detect duplication and speciation events in this gene tree.
say_en.note: Annotates each node with evolutionary type.

say_en.text: Annotate the leaf nodes of this tree with NCBI taxonomy.
say_en.note: Adds lineage and taxid for each species.
